entities.summary: Betty MacDonald was an American author who specialized in humorous autobiographical tales, and is best known for her book The Egg and I. She also wrote the Mrs. Piggle-Wiggle series of children's books. She is associated with the Pacific Northwest, especially Washington. Betty MacDonald was a authors & novelists from Boulder (1907-03-26, Boulder–1958-02-07). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
